GOV-F-003-S142.title: Lock Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S142.description: Define and persist lock schema including lock_id, owner_id, ttl_expiry, heartbeat_ts, and status. Enforce schema validation and required fields for all lock operations.

GOV-F-003-S143.title: Lock Management API Endpoints
GOV-F-003-S143.description: Expose internal APIs for lock acquire, heartbeat, release, and recovery status. Ensure consistent request/response contracts and error handling for ownership and expiration cases.

GOV-F-003-S144.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S144.description: Integrate lock acquisition, heartbeat, and recovery into brain_runner execution flow to ensure single-agent control and safe retry behavior during assignment processing.
